reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and I buy lighting from Wayfair, Amazon or Lowe's because I know how returns and delivery work there. Nothing here tells me it's UL listed, and I'm not sending $360 to a store I can't vet.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? The page doesn't say, and I'd pay return shipping on a fixture that turns out wrong. Delivery in 10 to 12 business days, or 6 weeks for made-to-order, is also slow for a renovation schedule.
would_change_my_mind: Clear UL/ETL listing on the product page, plus the same pendant on Wayfair or Amazon with Prime delivery and easy returns, or free return shipping and a lot of real customer reviews.
